title: 薄弱卡片排序打断到期学习步骤

history.evidence: Historical caller changed from a single mastery_queue_priority_key to a state-rank composite key. Backport expresses the exact old ordering in the current helper interface.

problem_zh: 启用掌握度优先排序后，已经到期的学习或重学卡会被低掌握度的新卡或普通复习卡插队，分钟级学习步骤被拖延。请修复队列优先级，并保证普通复习卡之间的薄弱优先及到期偏置边界仍然有效。
test_scope: Direct compilation of complete production Rust modules through #[path]; unrelated learner-profile dependency panics if invoked. No production function is copied.
